production_rule: Only production-approved sources may be consumed by release content builders.

sources.notes: Exact Tanzil Uthmani v1.1 txt-2 artifact preserved from the official Tanzil endpoint with pause marks, sajdah signs and rub-el-hizb signs. Sequential tanween and optional tatweel features were not requested.

sources.source_name: QuranEnc Arabic Language - Meanings of Words (As-Siraj fi Bayan Gharib Al-Quran)
sources.notes: Official QuranEnc lists this verse-scoped Arabic difficult-word resource as v1.0.0 and its API/republishing policy is version-aware. The content is a promising low-friction contextual-gloss source, not a morphology or Quran-text authority. No production bytes are consumed until an exact versioned upstream response/file set plus the applicable terms are preserved under project control with hashes and provenance.

Licence ambiguity requires resolution before promotion: the official download page presents GNU GPL/verbatim-copy terms, while the official FAQ also describes the data as research/non-commercial. Treat as non-production until the project obtains clarification or a clearly compatible authoritative licence basis.

Official HadeethEnc version-check endpoint reports Arabic translation v1.7.0 and the download surface exposes Arabic Excel/PDF under republication terms. Keep research-only until the exact v1.7.0 artifact, edition/collection/numbering provenance, licence snapshot, checksums and project-controlled mirror are preserved and reviewed.

Not suitable as a critical permanent mirrored source under the Developer Terms updated 2026-09-14, including redistribution/storage constraints. May be an optional online integration where those terms are satisfied.

Evaluate individual resources only. Official QUL morphology pages expose downloadable word-location keyed datasets, while the QUL FAQ requires checking dataset-specific licensing for commercial use. The QUL repository MIT licence is not treated as blanket permission for aggregated dataset bytes.

Technically suitable candidate: QUL documents a downloadable SQLite mapping lemmas to word_location keys. No artifact is mirrored because the inspected resource page does not state a dataset licence and QUL's FAQ requires resource-specific licence review before commercial production use.
